scientific_integrity: New claim is the rank-by-rank complementary-subalgebra incidence count; underlying subalgebra normal forms and Nijenhuis torsion are credited to prior sources; small exhaustive computations do not replace the general proof.
scientific_limitations: Counts individual idempotent Lie Nijenhuis operators, not arbitrary Nijenhuis maps, conjugacy orbits or nonreduced schemes. Arbitrary defining matrices require invariant-subspace and disjoint-pair counts. Independent mathematical and exhaustive historical-priority validation not performed.
title: Rank spectra of idempotent Nijenhuis projections on almost-Abelian Lie algebras
